inner_page.description: One page of an inner list instead of the ban page. contributions and claimants need the ban_ref of one ban, and the answer lists only that ban; orphan_claimants names no ban. cursor is contributions.next_cursor, hits.claimants_next_cursor, or orphan_hits.claimants_next_cursor of an earlier answer to the same target and window. Default and maximum limit: 500 contributions, 50 claimants. Never combined with page.cursor.
